species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 43°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 34–148 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 12–36 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
South wind at 16 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
